reviews.review_title: OK for free app, but felt unpolished
reviews.review_description:
Not trying to be harsh; just rating how I felt my time was spent coming out of the experience. It felt like a Windows 95 FMV sampler intro, but in 3D.

Music was cool and fit the vibe. Thumbs up there.

Not sure if it was intended for most of the video to be occurring behind my starting front view. That was a bit odd not being able to re-center most of the action to be in front of me.

The noise/grain filter being applied felt like it took away from the visuals going on. There were some moments that looked like they'd be super cool without getting as washed out.

The interactive moment at the start led me to think the experience was going to be more interactive, so it was a bit of a letdown when it turned into a 3D music video.

The visuals felt like they were sort of torn between being super dark, metal fantasy and trippy cartoony. Leaning heavier into one or the other might have made it feel more compelling.

Hope to see another project down the line though as there's definitely potential here!
I liked the interaction at the start. Good job.
